settings.description:
At Hamaragharr Vastu Corporation LLP, we aim to provide a smooth and reliable shopping experience by ensuring timely processing and delivery of your orders. This Shipping Policy explains how orders placed on www.hamaragharr.in/ are processed, shipped, and delivered.

1. Shipping Coverage

We ship domestically within India, subject to service availability and applicable regulations.

2. Shipping Charges

  • We offer free shipping on select products and locations.
  • Paid shipping may apply to certain orders based on product type, delivery location, order value.
  • Applicable shipping charges (if any) will be clearly displayed at checkout before payment.

3. Shipping Partners

To ensure reliable and timely delivery, we work with trusted logistics partners, including but not limited to:

  • Shiprocket
  • Delhivery
  • DTDC
  • Other reputed courier partners as required

4. Order Processing Time

  • Orders are typically processed and dispatched within 1–2 business days after successful payment confirmation.
  • Orders placed on weekends or public holidays will be processed on the next working day.
  • If we experience a high volume of orders or any unexpected delays, processing may take slightly longer. In such cases, we will keep you informed via email or phone regarding the revised timeline.

5. Delivery Timelines

Domestic Orders (India)

  • Minimum delivery time: Same-day delivery (available in select locations only)
  • Maximum delivery time: Up to 15 business days, depending on location and courier operations

Delivery timelines are estimates and may vary due to factors beyond our control, including weather conditions, customs clearance, courier delays, or regional restrictions.

6. Order Tracking

Once your order is shipped:

  • A tracking number will be shared via email and WhatsApp
  • You can track your shipment directly on the courier partner's website using the provided tracking details

7. Order Updates & Communication

We keep you informed throughout the shipping process via:

  • Email notifications
  • WhatsApp updates (where applicable)

Please ensure that your contact details are accurate at the time of checkout to receive timely updates.

8. Damaged, Incorrect, or Missing Orders

If you receive:

  • A damaged product
  • An incorrect item
  • A package with missing contents

Please contact us immediately upon delivery at support@hamaragharr.in with your order ID and supporting images/videos. We will review the issue and arrange a replacement or resolution as per our Return, Exchange & Refund Policy.

9. Returns & Replacements

  • Returns and replacements are governed by our Return, Exchange & Refund Policy.
  • Replacements may be offered in cases of damaged items or quality issues, subject to verification.

10. Delays & Unforeseen Circumstances

While we strive to meet delivery timelines, Hamaragharr Vastu Corporation is not responsible for delays caused by:

  • Courier partner issues
  • Natural calamities or force majeure events
  • Incorrect or incomplete shipping address provided by the customer

11. Contact Information

For questions related to returns, exchanges, or refunds, please contact us:

📧 Email: support@hamaragharr.in
📞 Phone: +91 8130340819
